canonicalBytes: UTF-8, LF, JSON ensure_ascii=true/sort_keys=true/indent=2/final newline; XML ElementTree serialization UTF-8 declaration/LF final newline; SQL UTF-8/LF final newline. File integrity compares exact bytes after CRLF-to-LF checkout normalization only; no other normalization.
derivation: UTF-8 compact JSON arrays, ensure_ascii=true, separators=(comma,colon), no newline. Seed = SHA256([generator, 1701, category, mission-key, event-key]) where generator is "missions-generator-1" for the 31 missions carried from release 1.0 (so they are reproduced byte for byte) and "missions-generator-2" for everything else; mission-key is the canonical ST-... missionId for cost/timing streams of curated and generated missions, a recipe key (for example maint-007 or routine-042) for recipe, staffing and edge-case streams, the v1 crew id for crew_reference, and empty for initial offset streams; event-key is empty for initial offsets, "initial" for initial estimates, "causal-start" for causal start delay, otherwise the event key. Blocks = SHA256(seed bytes + unsigned 64-bit big-endian counter starting at zero). Uniform inclusive integer draw uses 256-bit rejection sampling.
ordering: Fixed input roster: the 31 carried missions, the 57 new curated canon missions, the 45 generated maintenance missions, the 167 generated routine missions. Sequential mission ordinals after release 1.0's last. Change ids: the 101 of release 1.0 unchanged, then the new entries numbered from 1.0's next change id in order of changedAt, missionId and local event index among themselves.

references.limitation: Missions-local opaque IDs; no suffix/alias-based Personnel mapping or canonical external registry claim.

participants.O-860: Wesley Crusher as a returning visitor (an outsider, not Crew)

objectives: Exercise the evacuation of the whole ship and time every deck.
Screen the whole crew and civilian roster for the scheduled medical review.
Run the emergency drill on every deck and record the response times.
Escort the relocation convoy between starbases with a full complement.

DIPLOMATIC: Escort the delegation to {place} and support the talks without taking a side.
Provide transport and protocol support for the envoy at {place}.
EXPLORATION: Chart the region around {place}, release probes and record the findings.
Survey unexplored space near {place} and mark points of interest.
HUMANITARIAN: Deliver relief supplies to {place} and help distribute them.
Plan and support the evacuation of residents from {place}.
MEDICAL: Run the scheduled medical outreach at {place} and record the cases treated.
Support the local clinic at {place} with staff and supplies.
RESCUE: Respond to the distress call near {place} and recover anyone found.
Search the area near {place} for survivors and report findings.
SCIENTIFIC: Collect and analyse sensor data on {subject} near {place} and file a findings report.
Characterise {subject} at {place} and record the readings for the science archive.
SECURITY: Patrol the approaches to {place}, challenge unidentified traffic and log all contacts.
Secure the area around {place} and report any incident to command.
TRANSPORT: Move the assigned cargo and passengers to {place} on schedule and confirm delivery.
Carry the scheduled load to {place}, handle the transfer and report any loss.

terminalTiming: Final terminal event is fixed to first event plus durationHours; closure dwell can exceed a draw band and is explicitly labeled duration-closure. Nonterminal draws are bounded by remaining duration and minimum future gaps.
